Elements hidden via inline style="font-size:0" render nothing and must not appear in the output

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<p>visible</p><div style="font-size:0px; color:rgb(255,255,255)"><span style="line-height:0">secret zero size text</span></div><p>also visible</p>"#;
    let options: ConversionOptions = Default::default();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone())).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.content);
}
```
